metadata.title: Middle School A+++ Introductory Cursive Writing — 13-Week Course
research_basis: South Carolina Department of Education Handwriting Support Document (2025)
California Department of Education Cursive Instruction guidance (reviewed 2026)
Common Core State Standards ELA/Literacy writing and language expectations

course_goals: Learn lowercase and uppercase forms through related stroke families.
Develop joining, spacing, alignment, proportion, and legibility.
Transition from isolated letters to authentic writing.
Build confidence reading and producing cursive.

weeks.weekly_goal: Build mastery of handwriting reset & cursive readiness with accuracy, fluency, legibility, and purposeful written communication.

lessons.title: Posture and Grip
objectives: Develop accurate, legible, controlled cursive letterforms and joins.
Build fluency through short, deliberate practice rather than repetitive copying alone.
Apply handwriting to authentic reading, note-taking, correspondence, and composition.
activities: Teacher/model analysis followed by guided formation.
lessons.assessment: Legibility, consistency, spacing, alignment, joins, fluency, and self-correction.
lessons.extension: Increase writing length, vary text type, or create an individualized handwriting challenge.
